questions.question: What is the difference between a regular and an irregular polygon? Give an example of each.
questions.expected_answer: A regular polygon has all sides equal and all angles equal, like a square or a stop sign. An irregular polygon does not, like a rectangle that is 6 m by 3 m.

questions.question: Name a polygon with 7 sides and a polygon with 8 sides.
questions.expected_answer: A polygon with 7 sides is a heptagon. A polygon with 8 sides is an octagon, like a stop sign.

questions.question: Explain why a circle is not a polygon.
questions.expected_answer: A polygon is a closed shape made only of straight sides. A circle has a curved edge and no straight sides, so it is not a polygon.
